zh.title: 星宇航空將於2027年開闢高雄至神戶與沖繩航線
zh.summary: 星宇航空將於2027年1月1日起開闢高雄至神戶與沖繩航線，每日各一班。
body: 星宇航空於2026年8月21日宣布進軍高雄市場，計畫自2027年1月1日起開闢高雄往返神戶及高雄往返沖繩兩條日本新航線。這是星宇航空首度在高雄設立定期航點。
根據星宇航空規劃，高雄—神戶與高雄—沖繩兩條新航線開航初期均為每日一班，將採用空中巴士A321neo新世代客機執飛。神戶市與星宇航空已於神戶市政廳舉行發表會，由星宇航空策略長劉允富、神戶市長久元喜造及關西機場本部長西尾裕共同主持。
星宇航空表示，隨著高雄航線的加入，公司將完成台灣北部、中部及南部三地的航網布局，未來旅客可自由搭配台北、台中與高雄不同地點進出。

en.title: Starlux Airlines to Launch Kaohsiung Routes to Kobe and Okinawa in January 2027
en.summary: Starlux Airlines will launch daily Kaohsiung flights to Kobe and Okinawa starting January 2027 using A321neo aircraft.
body: Starlux Airlines announced on August 21, 2026, that it will expand into Kaohsiung by opening routes to Kobe and Okinawa starting January 1, 2027. This marks the carrier's first establishment of regular scheduled destinations in Kaohsiung.

The airline plans to operate daily flights on both the Kaohsiung-Kobe and Kaohsiung-Okinawa routes using Airbus A321neo aircraft. Kobe City and Starlux held a press conference at Kobe City Hall, hosted by Starlux Chief Strategy Officer Liu Yun-fu, Kobe Mayor Kizo Hisamoto, and Kansai Airports Executive Officer Hiroshi Nishio.

Starlux noted that adding Kaohsiung will complete its network coverage across northern, central, and southern Taiwan, allowing passengers flexibility to enter and depart via Taipei, Taichung, or Kaohsiung.

zh.title: 美上訴法院撤銷運輸部命令 准達美與墨航合資企業繼續營運
zh.summary: 美國上訴法院撤銷運輸部處分，允許達美航空與墨西哥航空繼續以合資模式營運。
body: 美國聯邦第十一巡迴上訴法院於2026年8月20日作出裁決，撤銷美國運輸部（DOT）先前要求達美航空（Delta Air Lines）與墨西哥航空（Aeroméxico）拆解其跨境合資企業的行政命令。這項裁決允許兩家航空公司在2016年獲得的反托拉斯豁免權架構下，繼續協調美國與墨西哥之間航班的班表、票價以及運能分配。
上訴法院在判決中指出，運輸部未能合理說明為何在本案中採用了較以往航空公司聯盟審查大幅縮減的市場分析模式。在2016年最初批准該項合作時，運輸部針對整個美墨市場以及1,687個城市對進行了全面審查；但在2025年的重新審查中，運輸部卻主要關注墨西哥城貝尼托·胡亞雷斯國際機場（MEX）的營運狀況，該機場約佔美墨兩國間航班總量的21%。
法院補充指出，運輸部在2025年的最終命令中，並未包含更新後的航空公司市場占有率資料，亦未分析若合資企業繼續運作，相關市占率將如何變化，同時也未對個別城市對市場進行新的評估。上訴法院表示，運輸部在未提供合理解釋的情況下，劇烈偏離過去分析國家對與城市對的統一做法，因此該行政命令屬於任意且反覆無常的處分。
這起監管爭議源於墨西哥政府推行的航空政策，包括減少墨西哥城貝尼托·胡亞雷斯國際機場（NLU）的可分配起降時間（slots），以及強制將貨運業務轉移至費利佩·安吉利斯國際機場。美方官員認為相關政策扭曲了市場競爭，並違反2015年《美墨航空運輸協定》，促使美國運輸部於2025年9月決定撤銷對達美航空與墨西哥航空合資企業的批准與反托拉斯豁免權。
由於上訴法院先前已於2025年11月暫緩執行運輸部的拆解命令，達美航空與墨西哥航空的合資企業在此期間始終維持營運。裁決公佈後，兩家航空公司對此表示歡迎，墨西哥航空亦確認其合資架構與反托拉斯豁免權繼續有效。不過，法院亦澄清該裁決僅針對運輸部程序與分析上的缺失進行撤銷，並未就該合資企業是否有助於市場競爭做出最終結論。

en.title: US Appeals Court Overturns DOT Order to Dismantle Delta-Aeroméxico Joint Venture
en.summary: US appeals court overturns order requiring Delta Air Lines and Aeroméxico to dismantle their joint venture.
body: The 11th US Circuit Court of Appeals vacated a Department of Transportation (DOT) order on August 20, 2026, that would have required Delta Air Lines and Aeroméxico to dismantle their cross-border joint venture. The appellate court's decision enables both carriers to maintain their commercial partnership and continue coordinating flight schedules, ticket pricing, and capacity under the antitrust immunity originally granted to them in 2016.

In its ruling, the court determined that the DOT failed to provide a reasonable explanation for applying a far narrower competitive evaluation than it had historically utilized in previous airline alliance reviews. When the regulatory agency initially approved the partnership in 2016, it conducted a comprehensive examination of competition across the entire US-Mexico market and 1,687 individual city pairs. In contrast, the DOT's 2025 review focused primarily on slot conditions at Mexico City International Airport (MEX), which accounts for approximately 21% of total flights between the two nations.

The court emphasized that the department's final order lacked updated airline market share data, omitted any prospective analysis of how market shares might evolve if the joint venture continued, and failed to execute a fresh evaluation of individual city-pair markets. Consequently, the appellate panel held that the DOT's action was arbitrary and capricious, as the agency departed drastically from its uniform practice of analyzing country-pair and city-pair markets without justifying why such comprehensive reviews were unnecessary in this instance.

The regulatory dispute originated from policies enacted by the Mexican government, including mandatory reductions in available slots at Mexico City International Airport  and a decree relocating all dedicated cargo operations from MEX to Felipe Ángeles International Airport (NLU (NLU)). US authorities argued these actions distorted market competition and breached the 2015 US-Mexico Air Transport Agreement, prompting the DOT to issue its September 2025 order revoking approval and antitrust immunity for the carriers' alliance.

Because the appeals court had previously issued a stay on the DOT order in November 2025, Delta Air Lines and Aeroméxico were never forced to dissolve their joint venture. Both airlines welcomed the latest judicial decision, with Aeroméxico confirming that the joint venture and its antitrust immunity remain fully active. The court clarified that its ruling addresses the department's analytical and procedural shortcomings rather than making a definitive finding on whether the partnership itself is pro-competitive.

zh.title: 聯合航空完成丹佛飛行訓練中心首期擴建 引進40台CAE模擬機
zh.summary: 聯合航空於丹佛訓練中心新增40台CAE模擬機；完成首期擴建；營運52台全動態模擬機
body: 聯合航空已完成其位於丹佛的飛行訓練中心第一階段擴建工程，在引進40台由CAE製造的新型飛行模擬機與訓練設備後，進一步擴充該設施的訓練能量。隨著新設備投入營運，聯合航空目前在該訓練中心共營運52台全動態飛行模擬機與34台固定式訓練設備，為旗下近1,8000名現役機師及新進機組人員提供訓練服務。
這座佔地22英畝的訓練園區位於丹佛的中央公園社區，包含8棟建築物與近70萬平方英呎的訓練空間。聯合航空表示，該中心每日最高可訓練860名機師，每年可執行超過3萬2,000場訓練任務。訓練中心全年運作362天且24小時不間斷營運，機師在取得初始資格後，每9個月均需返回丹佛進行定期複訓。
作為自2022年啟動的擴建專案之一部分，聯合航空於2024年在園區內啟用一座面積達15萬平方英呎的新建築。該公司為該設施投資超過1億4,500萬美元，專為容納更多全動態模擬機、教室及支援區域而設計。自2016年以來，聯合航空已對該園區累計投資3億7,000萬美元，並在訓練中心創造了超過300個額外工作機會。
此外，聯合航空已開始籌備位於丹佛國際機場（DEN）附近的下一階段擴建計畫。丹佛市議會於2026年7月批准了兩塊未開發土地的重新劃定申請。聯合航空預計於2027年動工興建新設施，並計畫於2030年正式投入營運，屆時將與現有的中央公園園區共同運作。自2021年推出United Next成長戰略以來，聯合航空已招聘超過9,500名機師，其中2026年上半年即新增約700名機師。

en.title: United Airlines Completes Phase One Expansion at Den (DEN)ver Pilot Training Center
en.summary: United Airlines completes phase one expansion at Denver training center; adds 40 CAE flight simulators.
body: United Airlines has completed the first phase of an expansion at its Denver Flight Training Center following the addition of 40 new CAE flight simulators and training devices. With these new devices in place, the airline now operates 52 full-motion flight simulators and 34 fixed training devices at the facility, supporting training operations for nearly 18,000 active pilots as well as newly hired flight crews.

The 22-acre campus in Denver's Central Park neighborhood features eight buildings comprising nearly 700,000 square feet of training space. According to United Airlines, the facility can accommodate up to 860 pilots per day and conduct more than 32,000 training events annually. The center operates around the clock for 362 days each year, serving as the primary facility where United pilots complete qualification and return every nine months for recurrent training.

As part of the expansion project initiated in 2022, United Airlines opened a new 150,000-square-foot building at the campus in 2024. The airline invested over $145 million in the facility to accommodate additional full-motion simulators, classrooms, and support areas, bringing its total investment in the campus to $370 million since 2016. The expansion project has created more than 300 additional jobs at the training center.

United Airlines is also preparing for a subsequent expansion near Denver International Airport . In July 2026, the Denver City Council approved a rezoning request for undeveloped land purchased by the airline in 2023. United expects to begin construction on the new facility in 2027 and place it into operation by 2030 to run alongside the existing Central Park campus. Since launching its United Next growth strategy in 2021, the airline has hired more than 9,500 pilots, including approximately 700 pilots during the first part of 2026.

zh.title: 美賓州賽斯納150降落時撞擊警用直升機 釀1死2傷
zh.summary: 一架賽斯納150於賓州降落時撞擊警用直升機；小型飛機飛行員身亡；直升機兩人輕傷
body: 2026年8月19日，一架賽斯納150（Cessna 150）單引擎飛機在美國賓夕法尼亞州卡萊爾機場（CAX）嘗試降落時，與一架懸停中的賓夕法尼亞州警察局貝爾407（Bell 407）直升機相撞。事故導致小型飛機飛行員身亡，直升機上兩名人員受輕傷。
卡萊爾機場為無空中交通管制塔台的機場，事發時警用直升機正在草地上方進行例行訓練。撞擊造成直升機旋翼與尾桁斷裂並翻覆，兩名警員隨後脫困並送醫治療，目前情況穩定。賽斯納飛機上僅有飛行員一人，經證實已於事故中罹難。
美國國家運輸安全委員會（NTSB）已主導此起空中相撞事故的調查作業，美國聯邦航空局（FAA）與賓州警察局亦參與協助。目前調查單位尚未確定具體的事故原因。

en.title: Cessna 150 Collides With PSP Helicopter in Pennsylvania, Pilot Killed
en.summary: A Cessna 150 collided with a hovering police helicopter in Pennsylvania, killing the airplane pilot.
body: On August 19, 2026, a Cessna 150 collided with a hovering Pennsylvania State Police Bell 407 helicopter while attempting to land at Carlisle Airport (CAX) in Pennsylvania. The pilot of the Cessna airplane was killed in the accident, while two officers aboard the helicopter sustained minor injuries.

Carlisle Airport is an uncontrolled field without an air traffic control tower. At the time of the collision, the state police helicopter was conducting a routine training exercise. The impact severed the helicopter's rotor blades and tail boom, causing it to roll onto its side. Both troopers were able to escape and were transported to a hospital in stable condition.

The National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) is leading the investigation into the mid-air collision, assisted by the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) and the Pennsylvania State Police. Authorities stated that no official cause has been determined yet.
